title: HATEBENCH: Benchmarking Hate Speech Detectors on LLM-Generated Content and Hate Campaigns

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting various racial and ethnic groups.
Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting various religious groups.
Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting immigrants, migrants, refugees, and undocumented people.
Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting different gender identities including men, women, transgender, and non-binary individuals.
Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting different sexual orientations such as bisexual, gay, lesbian, and heterosexual.
Comparing the F1-scores of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated and human-written text targeting people with physical, cognitive, mental, visual, and hearing disabilities.
